summary: FirstService Corporation filed a Form 6-K on September 17, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing a routine quarterly cash dividend of US$0.305 per common share, declared by its Board of Directors. The dividend is payable October 7, 2026 to holders of record at the close of business on September 30, 2026, and qualifies as an eligible dividend for Canadian income tax purposes. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, review or activist event is disclosed. The filing is an ordinary capital-return announcement; watch only for future dividend policy changes or special distributions.
